steps.title: Initialize Modern Calculator Project
steps.description: Configure basic meta properties, package naming conventions, and environment attributes for Modern Calculator.

steps.title: Configure Root Build Script
steps.description: Generate the root-level build.gradle to specify the correct Android Gradle Plugin (AGP) version of 8.3.2.

steps.title: Create Project Settings Gradle Configuration
steps.description: Set up the repositories, repository rules, and declare the modular structures in settings.gradle.

steps.title: Configure App Build Gradle
steps.description: Establish compileSdk 34, targetSdk 34, and compatibility with Java 8 bytecode versions.

steps.title: Define Manifest and Theme Settings
steps.description: Configure standard application features, the main activity entry point, and system styles.

steps.title: Create Rounded Buttons Background Layouts
steps.description: Design state-based custom drawing layouts for numerical keys, symbols, action buttons, and operation states.

steps.title: Structure UI Display and Typography Grid
steps.description: Design the interface comprising numerical layouts, expression histories, responsive button weights, and action groupings.

steps.title: Program Main Interface Logic
steps.description: Develop UI element handlers, event dispatch mappings, and numeric calculation processing mechanisms.

steps.title: Implement Mathematical Execution Algorithms
steps.description: Create the arithmetic system including state transition definitions, floating-point formatting, and safety divisions.

steps.title: Assemble Display Update Procedures
steps.description: Implement the state display updates to sync application results smoothly to user visual views.

steps.title: Verify Java 8 Source Standard Compliance
steps.description: Validate the code structure to ensure no unsupported components, modern lambda syntax, or missing resources exist.

steps.title: Building Modern Calculator
steps.description: Execute the Gradle compilation pipeline using assembleDebug to bundle and emit the finished package.
